kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-normalization-categories --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --normalization-category-type entity --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNormalizationCategories

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Select the region for the Data Management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Assets are in the Chinese mainland.

- ap-southeast-1: Assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
- **zh**（默认）：中文。
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of this member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The type of the normalization rule category. Valid values:

- log

- entity
parameters.help_zh:
标准化规则类目类型。取值：
- log
- entity
parameters.name: normalization_category_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token
